field_alias.exception: inline formのラベルを親幅40%で制限し入力領域を残す配置比率。checkbox分岐と同じ構造用途。aliasの固定40%式だけに一致させ、任意の幅・別の上書き値は許可しない。

checkbox.exception: inline formのラベルが入力領域を奪わないよう親幅40%を上限とする配置比率。基準ラベル幅はsize.form-labelへ接続する。

templates/angular/form-field.ts.judgment: The new hint position and editor character width write separate host state. Only inline labelPosition still writes the 40% grid cap; the other label positions clear that alias. The declaration uses the form-level width or semantic form-label default as its other minimum operand.

templates/angular/form-layout.ts.judgment: The unchanged inherited label grid uses the fixed 40% cap with the approved semantic default or positive finite caller width.

templates/angular/styles.css.judgment: The non-checkbox selector still consumes the field or inherited label columns. The inline checkbox selector uses the same 40% cap directly, including when a projected wrapper contains the checkbox. Hint or editor width styling introduces no alternate label-cap operand. The alias approval retains the exact selector, declaration, alias value, and current source coordinates; the checker requires exactly one matching diagnostic.
